preconditions.description: N is a positive integer within the range [1, 20].

postconditions.expression: all(binary.count('1') >= binary.count('0') for binary in return_value)
postconditions.description: All binary numbers in the output have more than or equal 1's than 0's for any prefix.
The output contains all possible N-bit binary numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(binary) == N for binary in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each binary number in the output has exactly N bits.
The output list is sorted in decreasing order.
